narrative.overview:
This record governs the live music component, not the surrounding landing page
or the native settings application. The incumbent website retains its near-black
ground and Geist page typography. The component uses the native player's compact,
precise visual language and Inter typography.

The native authority is `../crates/islet-core/src/media.rs`, `island.rs`, and
`../crates/islet-render/src/lib.rs`, together with the shipped player captures in
`public/assets/shots/`. The built web implementation is recorded here; the
website's native app design records remain separate.
keyCharacteristics: Solid black island with translucent neutral controls.
Fixed native coordinates with uniform viewport scaling.
Shared sharp artwork through a finite geometry morph.
Actual media state, explicit source identity, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Clean Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the island solid black. The page grain sits below it (grain layer 79, island layer 80); page texture is not a player material.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve the native component's small, clear type ramp and real font weights. Scale the complete player to fit rather than independently resizing its labels.

rules.name: The Native Fidelity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the native geometry and scale the complete player uniformly on narrow viewports. The scale is min(1, max(0.1, (viewport width - 24) / outer player width)); no separate mobile composition is introduced. These coordinates are component measurements, not website-wide tokens.

rules.name: The Truthful Playback Rule
rules.body: Use actual audio time and events. Official catalog excerpts are accepted by the user; do not promise full-song openings. One active audio element and a lazy silent next-clip preloader serve the playlist. Playback is capped at 30 seconds; skips preserve pause intent and the latest selection. A bounded loading state leads to an explicit retry message on failure.

rules.name: The Finite Motion Rule
rules.body: Mouse hover opens after 250ms; leaving closes after 400ms. Title and artist remain visible for five seconds of playback before condensing. Keyboard focus and touch can open the player. The geometry morph lasts 0.55s; reduced motion applies final geometry immediately. Paused or hidden pages do not paint the audio clock. Preserve the incumbent page outside this component correction.

dos: - **Do** preserve native coordinates, artwork shape, and uniform scaling.
- **Do** use Inter with real weights and preserve visible keyboard focus.
- **Do** reflect actual media time, volume, mute, and recoverable failure state.
- **Do** identify the preview provider separately from Spotify track identity.
donts: - **Don't** apply the page grain or glow treatments to the player ground.
- **Don't** replace shared artwork with blurred duplicate artwork planes.
- **Don't** invent a mobile arrangement or promise full-song opening clips.
